answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the ivory of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A karst of per-task receipts records who did what, and the summit of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
